description: This file defines a Dropzone class that manages drag-and-drop image uploads within a rich text editor. It handles attaching event listeners for drag-and-drop interactions, shows visual cues, and invokes editor methods to insert images or paste content.

classes.name: Dropzone
classes.description: A class that manages drag-and-drop image uploads within the rich text editor, including event handling and UI updates.

methods.name: constructor(context)
methods.description: Initializes the Dropzone instance with context information and sets up the dropzone DOM element.

methods.name: initialize()
methods.description: Attaches event listeners for drag-and-drop interactions, either disabling default behavior or enabling custom handling.

methods.name: attachDragAndDropEvent()
methods.description: Sets up event handlers for dragenter, dragleave, drop, and related events to manage drag-and-drop UI cues and content insertion.

methods.name: destroy()
methods.description: Removes all event listeners attached by this Dropzone instance and performs cleanup.
